description: The accounting and finance that information systems professionals must understand to build and audit business software: double-entry bookkeeping, financial statements and their analysis, costing and budgeting, investment appraisal, accounting information systems, payroll and tax basics, and the controls that prevent and detect fraud. Every transaction is posted in a simulated ledger in the browser, traced through to the statements, and then implemented as data structures and controls in a small accounting system.
modelledOn: Wood and Sangster, Frank Wood's Business Accounting
Romney and Steinbart, Accounting Information Systems
IFRS Foundation, IFRS for SMEs Accounting Standard
outcomes: Record business transactions by double-entry bookkeeping through journals, ledgers and a trial balance, including period-end adjustments.
Prepare and interpret an income statement, statement of financial position and statement of cash flows, and analyse them with ratios.
Calculate product and service costs, prepare budgets and analyse variances to support management decisions.
Appraise IT and business investments using payback, accounting rate of return, net present value and internal rate of return.
Design the data model, transaction cycles and internal controls of an accounting information system.
Calculate payroll and basic tax obligations and identify control weaknesses that allow fraud.

units.title: Accounting and the business
topics: Why accounting matters to IS professionals; financial versus management accounting
Users of accounting information; the accounting equation: assets, liabilities and equity
Accounting concepts: accruals, going concern, consistency, prudence and materiality
The regulatory framework: IFRS, IFRS for SMEs and the Institute of Chartered Accountants, Ghana
Forms of business: sole traders, partnerships, companies, cooperatives and susu groups

units.title: Double-entry bookkeeping
topics: Debits and credits; the chart of accounts and account types
Books of prime entry: sales, purchases, cash book and general journal; posting to the ledger
Balancing accounts and the trial balance; errors the trial balance does and does not reveal
Period-end adjustments: accruals, prepayments, depreciation, inventory and bad debts
Bank reconciliation, including mobile money wallet and agent float accounts
Bookkeeping for a market trader in Kumasi from sales notebook to ledger

units.title: Financial statements
topics: The income statement: revenue recognition, cost of sales, gross and net profit
The statement of financial position: current and non-current assets and liabilities; equity
The statement of cash flows by the direct and indirect methods; profit versus cash
Ratio analysis: profitability, liquidity, efficiency and gearing ratios; limitations of ratios
Reading the published annual report of a listed company on the Ghana Stock Exchange

units.title: Costing
topics: Cost classification: direct and indirect, fixed and variable, product and period costs
Absorption costing and overhead allocation; activity-based costing
Marginal costing, contribution and cost-volume-profit analysis; break-even charts
Relevant costing for decisions: make or buy, pricing and limiting factors
Costing a bag of processed shea butter for a women's cooperative

units.title: Budgeting and performance
topics: The budgeting process: sales, production, cash and master budgets
Fixed and flexible budgets; variance analysis for materials, labour and overheads
Cash flow forecasting for small businesses and seasonal trades
Budgeting for an IT department: capital and operating expenditure; total cost of ownership

units.title: Investment appraisal
topics: The time value of money: compounding, discounting and annuities
Payback and accounting rate of return
Net present value and internal rate of return; conflicts between them; profitability index
Inflation, high interest rates, risk and sensitivity analysis in investment decisions
Sources of finance: equity, loans, leases, microfinance and mobile lending
Appraising a solar power and server investment for a rural clinic

units.title: Accounting information systems
topics: Transaction processing cycles: revenue, expenditure, production, payroll and financing
Data modelling for accounting: the REA model and relational design of ledgers and journals
Implementing double entry in software: balanced transactions, immutability, reversal entries and rounding
Documentation: data flow diagrams, flowcharts and business process diagrams for AIS
Accounting packages, ERP finance modules and cloud accounting for SMEs; e-invoicing
Integrating mobile money payments and bank feeds

units.title: Payroll and tax basics
topics: Payroll calculation: gross pay, allowances, overtime and net pay
Statutory deductions in Ghana: PAYE income tax bands and SSNIT pension tiers
Value added tax and related levies; withholding tax; filing with the Ghana Revenue Authority
Payroll systems, payslips and posting payroll to the general ledger
Corporate tax principles and tax compliance for small businesses

units.title: Financial controls and fraud
topics: Internal control frameworks: the COSO components of control
Segregation of duties, authorisation, reconciliation and physical controls; application controls in software
The fraud triangle; common frauds: ghost employees, fictitious suppliers, skimming and lapping
Audit trails, continuous auditing, Benford's law and data analytics for fraud detection
Capstone: building and auditing a small double-entry accounting system for a susu group
